name: SynCore
description: Cognitive micro-kernel with sequential thinking, memory, task management, and code intelligence

tools.name: memory.store
tools.description: Stores a key-value pair into SynCore's memory

tools.name: memory.query
tools.description: Queries a value from SynCore's memory by key

tools.name: task.create
tools.description: Creates a new task with a goal

tools.name: vector.insert
tools.description: Inserts text into vector memory for semantic search

tools.name: vector.search
tools.description: Searches vector memory for semantically similar content

tools.name: logs.tail
tools.description: Returns the last N entries from markdown logs

tools.name: parser.analyze
tools.description: Analyzes code structure and extracts functions, classes, imports, and variables

tools.name: parser.search
tools.description: Searches for patterns in code files using ripgrep

tools.name: code.explain
tools.description: Explains code using local Ollama LLM. Can explain specific functions or entire files.

tools.name: code.index_directory
tools.description: Index all code files in a directory matching a glob pattern. Extracts functions, classes, and relationships for semantic search.

tools.name: code_graph.index
tools.description: Index a Rust source file into the Code Intelligence Graph. Extracts imports, functions, calls, structs, traits, and implementations with semantic embeddings.

tools.name: code_graph.query
tools.description: Query the Code Intelligence Graph for function relationships including callers, callees, and semantically similar functions.

tools.name: code_graph.explain
tools.description: Get a comprehensive explanation of a function including its signature, callers, callees, and implementation context.

tools.name: code_graph.impact
tools.description: Analyze the impact of modifying a function by finding all callers and dependent code paths.

tools.name: code_graph.refactor_check
tools.description: Run comprehensive refactoring analysis detecting long functions, dead code, and duplicate functions.

tools.name: code_graph.refactor_symbol
tools.description: Generate a detailed refactoring plan for a specific symbol (function, struct, or trait).
